headline: Public hearings on demolition review rules, Oak Hill Road, and a $70,589.24 opioid fund transfer.
summary: Several federal Community Development Block Grant requests are on the agenda, including $750,000 for Families in Transition and $230,000 for the Boys & Girls Club. Other items include police union contract funding, a School Street parking ordinance, and a proposed commercial clean energy district.
